summary.text: Ela Chapin (Elanor Chapin) is a Democratic state representative from Vermont's Washington-5 District who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her background is in agricultural and housing and conservation programs.

paragraphs.text: Ela Chapin was born in Calais, Vermont, and lives in East Montpelier.

She earned a bachelor's degree in environmental science from Brown University in 1998 and a master's degree in policy and planning from Tufts University in 2006, along with a certificate in nonprofit management from Marlboro College.
Her career experience includes working as special programs coordinator for the Central Vermont Solid Waste Management District and as viability director of the Vermont Housing & Conservation Board.
She co-founded the Agricultural Viability Alliance and founded the National Farm Viability Conference.
Chapin assumed office in the Vermont House on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
